useCases.title: inGo - Digital, Verifiable and Secure Subcontractor Management Including Physical Access
useCases.summary:
Checking documents, monitoring deadlines, and granting site access for subcontractors is still often handled manually, with paper folders and spreadsheets - on construction sites, in logistics, and in technical services alike.
inGo digitalizes this process using decentralized identities (DIDs), digital wallets, and Verifiable Credentials (VCs), built on open standards (OpenID4VCI/VP, EUDI Wallet ARF) so it interoperates with other EUDI-ARF-conformant wallets rather than locking participants into a single vendor.
Employees receive credentials - such as site certificates, ID cards, work permits, or safety training - directly in their personal wallet. Using selective disclosure (SD-JWT VC), they can prove only what's required for a check, e.g. a valid access permit, without revealing unrelated personal data.
General contractors gain a real-time, cryptographically verifiable overview of credentials, deadlines, and site access. Subcontractors manage documents and credentials for their employees once and reuse them across projects - replacing manual paper checks with instant, auditable verification, on a secure, privacy-preserving, GDPR-compliant foundation.

issuers.labelRaw: General contractors and subcontractors (issuing site and access credentials); external trusted issuers such as government authorities, insurance companies, or certification bodies (planned)

credentials.labelRaw: Site Certificate, ID Card, Work Allowance, Visa, Social Security, Minimum Wage. The inGo system allows additional credential types like Safety Training and many more.

rps.labelRaw: General contractors / site management, access control systems (turnstiles), authorities/customs during inspections

useCases.userJourney:
inGo enables a range of processes built on wallets and Verifiable Credentials: 
1.	Onboarding: General contractors and subcontractors set up business wallets to manage employees and share project access.
2.	Issuance: Subcontractors and general contractors issue credentials (site certificates, ID cards, work permits, safety training) as Verifiable Credentials into each employee's personal wallet.
3.	Verification: The credentials are used to gain a verified site access, at site entrances (e.g. turnstiles) or during inspections inGo can tell if all required documents are available and valid in seconds - no paper, no manual lookup.
4.	Selective disclosure: Employees share only the specific attribute needed (e.g. "valid access permit: yes"), not full documents.
5.	Audit trail: Every verification is logged in an auditable, GDPR-compliant record.
External trusted issuers - e.g. government authorities, insurance companies, or certification bodies - are planned as additional issuers (e.g. state-verified identity, insurance proof).
